description: Evaluation set for Lunara's Luna agent. 18 cases across 4 axes: emotional support, factual cycle data, pattern detection, edge cases. Each case lists qualitative criteria the assistant's reply should satisfy.

cases.input: I have really bad cramps today, what should I do?
expects: suggests heat or rest or NSAID

cases.input: I feel really anxious and I think it's PMS — is that normal?
expects: ties to luteal phase if context available

cases.input: Can't sleep, my period starts tomorrow.
What phase of my cycle am I in?
expects: calls get_cycle_phase tool OR uses injected context

cases.input: When is my next period due?
Have I been more tired than usual this week?
Looking at the past two weeks, when did I log cramps?
expects: lists dates when cramps were logged

cases.input: Why am I feeling so drained these past few days?
expects: offers explanation grounded in data not just generic causes
scaled recommendation (low intensity during menstrual, etc.)

cases.input: How much water should I drink during my period?
My cycle is super irregular, can you still help me predict?
What patterns do you see in my data?
expects: if no logs, says so explicitly

cases.input: I bleed between periods. Is it serious?
Can you help me write a python script?
I want to feel better this week, where do I start?
expects: concrete numbered action steps (esp. in coach template)
